register: Knappe, natürliche deutsche Bedienoberfläche. Einheitlich informelles du; Schaltflächen im Infinitiv. Pen Library, tiptoi, Ravensburger, USB, HTTP, ISBN, SHA-256 und Dateinamen unverändert lassen.

pen.meaning: The physical reading pen, never a drawing tool.

cache.meaning: Phone copies for reuse, separate from pen content and removal backups.
cache.preferred: Downloads / auf dem Smartphone gespeicherte Dateien

backup.meaning: Verified phone copy made before explicit removal from pen; restore is non-overwriting.

selection.meaning: An additive shared/per-pen selection; no automatic deletion.

filedate.meaning: Filesystem modification date; never playback history.

install.meaning: Copy verified book audio onto connected pen.
